_comment: Shared, NON-SECRET MCP server definitions — single source of truth for both Claude Code (~/.claude.json) and Claude Desktop. NO Docker: every server here is a plain stdio launcher (npx/go/uvx). Secret env values (karakeep token) are injected at apply time from OpenBao by the merge scripts. Three servers are NOT listed here because their shape differs per-app or per-OS and the merge scripts inject them: outline is remote HTTP (http for Code, npx mcp-remote bridge for Desktop) with a baked Bearer token; signal is a per-OS stdio launcher (uv path + repo dir differ macOS vs Linux) talking to the signal-cli daemon (tcp 127.0.0.1:7583). github is NOT an MCP server at all anymore — all GitHub operations go through the `gh` CLI. Edit here, then chezmoi apply.

aws._comment: AWS MCP Server (GA 2026). The SERVER is remote and managed by AWS; mcp-proxy-for-aws is the local stdio bridge that signs each request with SigV4. Credentials come from AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE (rendered by Vault Agent as INI with a [agent-readonly] profile) via AWS_PROFILE — not from the interactive shell env, which is why this now works in Claude Desktop and harness-launched agents. See dotfiles#136.
